blocks.title: System testing
blocks.text: System testing testing ki oonchi satah hai jis mein poora software nizam ek hi cheez ke taur par test hota hai. Testers us ki majmooi functionality, performance, security aur tay shuda requirements ki paasdari jaanchte hain.

Yeh aise mahaul mein hoti hai jo asal (production) mahaul se bohat milta jhulta ho, ta ke software haqeeqi halaat mein jaancha jaye. Yeh mukhtalif hisson ke taamul se paida hone wali khamiyan pakarti aur tasdeeq karti hai ke software apna maqsad poora kare.

blocks.prompt: System testing asal jaise mahaul mein kyun hoti hai?
blocks.explanation: Ta ke software un halaat mein jaancha jaye jin ka use asal mein samna hoga, aur woh masail samne aayein jo sirf poore nizam ke haqeeqi halaat mein chalne par hote hain.

items: System testing: poora nizam ek saath; functionality, performance, security, paasdari; production jaise mahaul mein.
